topic.title: Release Notes - Version 2.0
topic.shortdesc: What's new in the GrainFlow X50 version 2.0.

section.title: Introduction
section.p: We are pleased to announce the release of GrainFlow X50 version 2.0. This release includes significant improvements in performance, safety, and connectivity.

ul.li: Remote Monitoring: Connect to the GrainFlow X50 via IoT to monitor performance remotely.
Energy Efficiency Mode: Reduces power consumption by 15% during low-load operation.
Self-Calibrating Sensors: New sensor technology automatically adjusts for ambient conditions.
Multi-Language Interface: HMI now supports 8 languages.
Predictive Maintenance: AI-driven alerts for potential failures.
Advanced Analytics: Detailed performance dashboards and reports.
Reliability: New bearing design increases lifespan by 25%
Fixed issue with sensor calibration at startup
When using high throughput (>70 TPH), slight vibration may occur. This is being addressed for v2.1.
